title: 6.11 Which Bus Do I Need?
unit_outcome: Name places in town, say how you travel and where places are, ask for and give directions, and read bus and train times.
goal: Ask Welcher Bus fährt zum Museum? and say Ich nehme den blauen Bus.
grammar_function: Welcher Bus fährt zum/zur + place? Ich nehme den + color + -en + Bus.
speaking_outcome: Choose a bus and buy a ticket.
